abstract: The prognostic factors of disease progression were studied in a prospective study in patients with Stage I non-seminomatous testicular tumours. Patients received no treatment after orchiectomy until progression of disease was confirmed. The results showed a good correlation between sperm counts in semen collected around the time of orchiectomy and progression of disease. While progression of disease occurred in 9 of the 20 patients with sperm counts lower than 10 X 10(6)/ml, it was not found in any of the patients with a sperm count exceeding 10 X 10(6)/ml.
abstract_ja: 病期Iの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者を対象とした前向き研究で、病勢進行の予後因子を検討した。精巣摘除術後は進行が確認されるまで治療を行わなかった。精巣摘除術の時期前後に採取した精液中の精子数と病勢進行との間には、良好な相関が認められた。精子数10×10⁶/mL未満の20例中9例で進行を認めたが、精子数10×10⁶/mL以上の例では進行は認めなかった。
